candidates.change_summary: Remove the requirement that _tos has at least one element, allowing empty arrays to fall through and return true.
Change the transferFrom selector to a different function selector, causing different external calls and typically different success/failure and return behavior.
Replace the loop condition with true, making the loop potentially infinite and changing whether the function completes.
Change the loop increment to decrement i, altering iteration order/count and observable call behavior.
Swap the arguments to abi.encodeWithSelector so the selector is encoded as the first argument, changing the external call and observable behavior.
Use the caller address instead of the from parameter in the external call encoding, changing transfer behavior.
Use index 0 for all recipients instead of _tos[i], changing which tokens are transferred.
Remove the success check so failed external calls are ignored, changing revert behavior and allowing transfer to complete with true.
Write the decoded return data to a storage-like variable through an empty expression, no; skip
Change the revert condition from if (!_s) to if (_s) so that successful sub-calls cause a revert.
Remove the require so that an empty _tos array no longer causes a revert, changing the observable return/outcome.
Replace 'require(_tos.length > 0)' with 'require(false)' so that every call to transfer always reverts.
Change return value from true to false.
Increase the loop bound by one, causing an extra call with an out-of-bounds address and changing behavior (likely revert).
